# FG-DOC-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_revision_check_out_of_time_refuses_the_create_retryably` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 文書の改訂の確認が時間内に終わらなかったため、マージリクエストは作られていません。しばらくしてからもう一度作成してください。
- en: The document revision check did not finish in time, so the merge request was not created. Try creating it again in a moment.
- id: Pemeriksaan revisi dokumen tidak selesai tepat waktu, sehingga merge request tidak dibuat. Coba buat lagi sebentar lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 13 §7.5 / ADR-0027 §1 (amendment 2026-11-28): `POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests` could not check the rule "one open revision per document" (FG-DOC-0006) for a transient reason, and the rule fails closed: nothing was created. `reason=budget` — deriving the documents the new merge request revises (git: the type definitions, two tree listings, the changed `.md` files) took longer than its budget (5 s, `timeout_ms`); `reason=git` — a git step of it timed out or git was busy or could not start (`cause_code` FG-GIT-0001 / 0002 / 0004); `reason=lock_busy` — the project's revision lock (the refusal, the create and the record of creates in this process run one at a time) was not free within 2 s; `reason=refuse_unavailable` — the open revisions could not be read from the database (`cause_code` FG-DB-*). Seen under load (a-burst: 32 creates at once in one project while the merge queue builds trains). Before 2026-11-28 the create went on without the rule (`forge.doc_revision.unavailable`, "the one-revision rule is skipped this time"). A document git cannot read (a missing object, a corrupt repository) is not transient: that still fails open (logged `forge.doc_revision.unavailable`), as reviewed in plan 13 stage 4.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event (`forge.web.request_failed`) carries `reason`, `cause_code` (when a step failed: look it up in the catalog), `timeout_ms`, `project_id` and the `request_id`. The same request's other events show what was slow (git spawns, `forge.git.*`, the database). Under a burst, check the host's load and git concurrency (`forge doctor`; `git.batch` per-repository processes). Read-only SQL of what the rule holds now: SELECT d.doc_id, d.lang, m.iid FROM forge.merge_request_documents d JOIN forge.merge_requests m ON m.id = d.merge_request_id WHERE d.project_id = <id> AND m.state = 'open'.

## 対処 (fix)

Create the merge request again: the request is safe to repeat (nothing was written). If it keeps failing, fix the slow dependency named by `cause_code` / the request's events (git storage, the database, host load).
